**SOCOM: U.S. Navy SEALs Fireteam Bravo 3 Fusion Fix (PPSSPP)** adds right-stick controls, intro skipping, and an option to speed up game loading.

[Website](https://thirteenag.github.io/wfp#fireteambravo3) · [Source Code](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/source/SOCOM.FireteamBravo3.PPSSPP.FusionFix/main.c) · [Default INI](https://github.com/ThirteenAG/WidescreenFixesPack/blob/master/data/SOCOM.FireteamBravo3.PPSSPP.FusionFix/memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/SOCOM.FireteamBravo3.PPSSPP.FusionFix/SOCOM.FireteamBravo3.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini)

</div>

---

## Options

- **Skip intro** — Skip startup intros.
- **Dual analog controls** — Enable right-stick support.
- **Loading** — Temporarily unthrottle the emulator during loading screens.

---

## Installation

1. Download the fix archive from this release.
2. Extract the archive into the directory containing PPSSPP’s `memstick` folder, preserving the folders in the archive.
3. Optionally edit `memstick/PSP/PLUGINS/SOCOM.FireteamBravo3.PPSSPP.FusionFix/SOCOM.FireteamBravo3.PPSSPP.FusionFix.ini` to configure the fix.
4. Launch the game in PPSSPP.
